column1: # Goals of the roadmap plan: one TSV row per goal (columns are separated by a TAB).
# parent and task are "-" when there is none; template is a file of dogfood/contracts/ without .json ("-" for none);
# params are NAME=VALUE,NAME=VALUE for render-contract.sh (RUN, TASK, REPO, BASE, TOOLS, CONTAINER_RUN are added by apply-goals.sh).
# Read by dogfood/apply-goals.sh. Titles and intents contain no tab and no pipe.
